title: Training Note: Medicare Part B Cost Sharing on Ancillary Claims (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
**The rule.** For a resident in the Part B tier of Ancillary and Optional Services Billing, Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B, a covered ancillary item is claimed to Medicare Part B and the resident is charged only the Part B cost sharing on the paid claim: first any part of the year's Part B deductible not yet met, then the Part B coinsurance percent of the remaining approved amount. The deductible of the calendar year of the service date applies. A claim's resident share is charged once.

## Questions and answers

**Which items does this concern?** Covered ancillary items in the categories Part B pays for a resident not in a Part A stay, claimed to Medicare Part B for a resident whose account is in Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B.

**How much of the deductible is already met?** The amounts of Part B share already posted as deductible for the calendar year of the service date, across all of the resident's Part B claims at the center, added together and capped at that year's deductible. The part not yet met is that year's deductible less the amount already met.

**Which year's deductible applies?** The deductible of the calendar year of the service date: USD 257.00 for 2025 and USD 283.00 for 2026. An item supplied on 30 December 2025 takes the 2025 deductible, whatever the date of the claim.

**What is the coinsurance percent?** The Part B coinsurance percent of the tier: 20 percent in Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B, and 0 percent in every other tier.

**In what order do the two parts apply?** The not-yet-met deductible is taken from the approved amount first; the coinsurance percent then acts on the approved amount that remains after that deductible part. The resident share is the deductible part plus the coinsurance part.

**How often is a claim's resident share charged?** Once. The record checked is the ledger of resident shares, by the Part B claim they name.

## Worked shares (hypothetical claims)

| Hypothetical case | Deductible part | Coinsurance part | Resident share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 service; USD 191.40 already met in 2026; approved amount USD 312.85 | USD 283.00 less USD 191.40, that is USD 91.60 | 20 percent of USD 221.25 (USD 312.85 less USD 91.60), that is USD 44.25 | USD 135.85 |
| 2026 service; 2026 deductible fully met; approved amount USD 57.35 | USD 0.00 | 20 percent of USD 57.35, that is USD 11.47 | USD 11.47 |
| 2025 service; nothing met in 2025; approved amount USD 64.20 | USD 64.20 (less than the USD 257.00 not yet met) | 20 percent of USD 0.00 | USD 64.20 |
